games.description: Play the classic Tetris block puzzle online. Arrange falling Tetriminos, complete horizontal lines, build your score and challenge yourself to survive as the speed increases.
games.longDescription: Tetris is the iconic falling-block puzzle game. Different shaped pieces called Tetriminos descend into a rectangular playfield. games.description: Play Pac-Man online: guide the iconic yellow character through a maze, eat every pellet, collect power pellets and outsmart the four ghosts.
games.longDescription: Pac-Man is a classic maze-chase arcade game originally released by Namco in 1980. Guide Pac-Man through a maze, eat every dot and avoid four ghosts. Power pellets temporarily reverse the chase, allowing Pac-Man to eat the ghosts and earn extra points. The simple rules create a strategic challenge built around timing, route planning and quick reactions.
games.instructions: Use the arrow keys to guide Pac-Man through the maze. Eat all the small pellets to clear the level, and collect large power pellets to turn the ghosts blue and temporarily make them vulnerable. Avoid ghosts when they are chasing you. On touch devices, use the on-screen controls or swipe if supported by the game.

games.longDescription: Drift Boss is a one-button arcade driving game built around precise timing.
